name: Coldseam The Disgraced Arbiter's Exit Suit
description:
Once a Tier-5 judicial robe set, now stripped of insignia and worn into something else entirely. The foundation is a heavy charcoal-and-deep-burgundy brocade longcoat — Spire-quality fabric, unmistakable to anyone who knows — but the corponation seals have been cut out, leaving raw rectangular voids at collar and cuffs. Beneath: a plain white high-collar shirt, hand-pressed, slightly yellowed. Trousers are the original matched brocade, knife-creased out of habit. Shoes are Tier-5 oxfords, re-soled with Shelf rubber — the only practical concession to a new life.

A BCI-port at the temple is exposed, no cosmetic cap. A second port at the base of the skull has been physically sealed with epoxy — something was removed, permanently.
functionality: Spire-grade thermal regulation brocade retains passive warmth, re-soled oxfords provide Shelf-viable traction, exposed BCI port functional, sealed rear port indicates removed implant — nature unknown.
what_it_says: This person fell from the highest tier and kept the coat — either as mourning or as warning.
manufacturer: Coldseam (self-assembled — original Spire garments, Shelf modifications)
price_range: Φ 50 – Φ 120 (current resale; original pieces worth Φ 40,000+)
story_hooks: The sealed skull port contained a judicial memory implant — whatever rulings and secrets were stored there are now inaccessible to everyone, including the wearer.
The raw voids where corponation seals were cut are the exact shape of the Ouroboros Compliance Division insignia — a very specific enemy was made.
A Tier-2 street kid recognizes the brocade pattern from a wanted bulletin; this person presided over a trial that condemned an entire Shelf neighborhood.
